notes: Privacy-safe support export. The existing diagnostic Copy report action becomes Share report: preview a frozen allowlisted snapshot, optionally include ten typed history events, then copy or save a new local .txt file. No addresses, device names, paths, raw logs, tokens or automatic upload. Pending/stale/missing observations are labelled rather than promoted to fresh results. Existing files are never overwritten by export. Five-file ordinary update, with no protected worker or network changes. Existing regression suites plus privacy-injection, native preview and save tests remain required.
